user.title: Choose whole-home meter
user.description: Select the HA power sensor that represents total whole-home consumption. Commissioning is available later from Configure.

init.title: Energy Attribution — Commissioning
init.description: {count} electrical-load candidates are in the private Energy Attribution environment. Select the devices to monitor. Training state is retained so longer-cycle training can continue in the background.

training_prepare.title: Prepare training

training_active.title: Training active
training_active.description: Training is active for {device} ({category}). Operate the device now. For a short test, turn it on and off as instructed. For a full-cycle appliance, run the complete cycle. The training state is retained while Configure is closed. When finished, check Finish.

training_review.title: Review training
training_review.description: Captured training for {device} ({category}). Observed peak change: {delta} W. Does the captured event resemble this device?

abort.no_candidates: No electrical-load candidates were found after filtering.
abort.device_not_monitored: That device is not selected for monitoring.
